title: Anderson Links
specs: Three nine-hole courses rotating for leagues
Hole competitions for tournaments with marked holes for closest to pin and longest drive
To rent a cart you must have a valid G1, G2 or G license
Proper golf attire required: soft spikes only, no sandals or open-toe shoes, socks must be worn
No children under 2 permitted on golf course; children over 2 must be playing or riding in cart
Tournaments and special events can be hosted with banquet facilities and meeting rooms

blurb: Guests play golf on three nine-hole courses with options for leagues and tournaments. The facility includes a driving range and a restaurant serving breakfast and other meals. Special events and banquets are also hosted on site.
extraNote: Reservations require valid credit card; no fee charged at booking unless paying in advance for 5% benefit · Cancellations or changes can be made online up to 24 hours in advance; rain checks provided for weather closures · Cancellations less than 2 hours, no shows, or short shows charged full green fee · Groups larger than 4 not permitted; solo players must pay for all unused tee times
